newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. reauthorizes three El Al routes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reauthorizes three El Al routes.

text.p: The United States told Israel and state airline El Al on Monday it had reauthorized three El Al routes between U.S. cities and Tel Aviv, Israeli officials said.

The El Al routes include flights from Baltimore-Washington, Orlando, Fla., which was due to operate during the summer, and a route from Dallas-Fort Worth, said Transport Ministry spokesman Avner Ovadiah.

Last week, the U.S. told Israel it had rescinded approval for the routes in response to an Israeli decision not to approve a New York-Athens-Tel Aviv route by New York-based Tower Air starting this summer.
"The Minister of Transport Yitzhak Levy has decided to answer positively the request of the American company Tower Air and permit it to fly the Tel Aviv-Athens-New York route," Ovadiah said.
Israel said last week it had rejected Tower's application because it had not been filed on time and told Tower it could begin the flights in October.
